data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Firebase Data Connect relational database service.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to connect to and use the Firebase Data Connect API. Enables building and scaling apps using a fully-managed PostgreSQL database powered by Cloud SQL.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app that uses Firebase Data Connect and PostgreSQL.
You need to manage relational database operations backed by Cloud SQL in Firebase.
avoid_when: You need production guarantees immediately, as the product is currently in Public Preview.
You are using a different backend database service like Supabase or standard Cloud Firestore.
strengths: Integrates directly with Firebase services and PostgreSQL.
Supports live queries and streaming updates.
weaknesses: Currently in Public Preview without standard SLA or deprecation guarantees.
Breaking changes can happen in minor version bumps.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Firebase Data Connect on the Firebase console, configuring schemas, and adhering to minimum SDK requirements like Android minSdk 24.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides an alternative fully-managed PostgreSQL backend service with robust Flutter integration.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer a NoSQL document database instead of a relational PostgreSQL database on Firebase.
